title: TypeSomething feature grid (v2)
description: A white section with a light centred heading (it can hold the bold-and-lime wordmark) and six hairline cards in a 3×2 grid: a small paper-coloured icon tile, an 18px title and a soft paragraph. One column on phones, two on tablets.
